# Backend interview question attribution

Source: https://github.com/ksundong/backend-interview-question

Authors: ksundong and repository contributors (https://github.com/ksundong/backend-interview-question/graphs/contributors).

Pinned revision: 71f0300c379837e2f5666bbe19630a3d3fbc2bb2.

The original README is preserved in backend-interview-question.md, including attribution and license statements. Its Information section states CC BY-NC-SA (Attribution–NonCommercial–ShareAlike); it also includes a CC BY-NC 2.0 KR link: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/2.0/kr/ . Both original notices are retained without asserting an unstated license version.

The imported question content is provided with attribution, for noncommercial use and under the same share-alike conditions. These conditions apply to the imported content, independently of the application code and the separately authored big-data supplement.

Changes: selected subject sections, split details into question/answer cards, decoded question HTML entities, normalized closing br tags for display, sanitized HTML. Original answer strings are preserved; empty source answers display an explicit placeholder. Communication, the miscellaneous question subsection, personal competency and latest-technology sections are excluded. Technical subsections under the broad 기타 heading (patterns, testing, infrastructure, etc.) remain.

Regenerate from the pinned source with `node frontend/scripts/import-interview-notes.mjs` from the repository root.
